home.heroTitle: Your ferry to a career in Germany
home.heroSubtitle: Karriere Fähre guides talent from Cameroon and Central Africa toward skilled jobs in Germany, and helps German companies find the workforce they're missing.
home.why1Body: Founded by a German-French-Cameroonian entrepreneur, Karriere Fähre understands both sides: the German labor market and Central African talent.
home.why2Body: German courses from A1 to B2, preparation for recognized exams, and support with integration.
home.why3Body: For candidates already at B2 level, direct support toward our partner companies in Germany.
home.fastTrackBody: Already at B2 level in German? Join our candidate pool and start your matching process with our partner companies.
home.fullTrainingBody: Starting out or at an intermediate level? Our complete A1 → B2 program prepares you for the exam and for integration before placement.
home.categoriesSubtitle: An overview of sectors where German companies are actively looking for skilled workers.

aPropos.title: About us
aPropos.intro: Karriere Fähre is an international placement agency based in Douala, Cameroon, founded by a German-French-Cameroonian entrepreneur.
aPropos.missionBody: Building a reliable bridge between talent from Central Africa and German companies facing a skilled-labor shortage, through training, integration preparation, and support at every step of placement.
aPropos.founderTitle: A founder who knows both sides
aPropos.founderBody: Having grown up between Germany and Cameroon, our founder understands both the demands of the German labor market and the aspirations of Cameroonian talent. Karriere Fähre (literally "the career ferry") carries that bridge in its name.
aPropos.value2: High standards in training and candidate preparation

aProposHistoire.title: Our story
aProposHistoire.subtitle: How Karriere Fähre grew out of a journey between two countries.
aProposHistoire.section1Body: Our founder grew up between Germany and Cameroon. She saw, on one side, German companies struggling to hire for essential jobs, and on the other, Cameroonian talent ready to train and contribute, but without a reliable bridge to connect them.
aProposHistoire.section2Body: Karriere Fähre was founded in Douala to close that gap: an organization that knows German requirements (language, qualification recognition, legal framework) and Cameroonian realities (training, support, trust) from the inside.
aProposHistoire.section3Body: "Fähre" means "ferry" in German. Like a ferry connects two shores, Karriere Fähre connects two labor markets, one candidate and one company at a time.

aProposMethode.title: Our method
aProposMethode.subtitle: A structured process, from first contact through to integration in Germany.
aProposMethode.section1Body: Every candidate takes a German placement test before any placement promise is made. We guide them to the right path, Fast Track or Full Training, rather than making unrealistic claims.
aProposMethode.section2Body: Our German courses follow the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR), with preparation for exams recognized by employers and German authorities.
aProposMethode.section3Body: On the company side, every account is validated by our team before any access to the candidate pool. On the candidate side, every profile is reviewed before becoming visible to partner companies.
aProposMethode.section4Body: Our role doesn't stop at the signed contract: we stay available during visa procedures and the first steps in Germany.

candidats.title: Understand & find your path
candidats.subtitle: Full support, from your first level test to placement in Germany.
candidats.step1Body: A German placement test to determine your path: Fast Track or Full Training.
candidats.step2Body: If needed, a complete A1 → B2 path with preparation for recognized exams.
candidats.step3Body: Join our candidate pool and get matched with our partner companies in Germany.
candidats.step4Body: Support with integration before and after departure.

candidatsComment.title: How it works
candidatsComment.subtitle: Four clear steps between your sign-up and your departure for Germany.
candidatsComment.section1Body: You create your candidate profile and take a German placement test, oral and written.
candidatsComment.section2Body: Already B2: you join our candidate pool directly. Below B2: you follow our full A1 → B2 training program.
candidatsComment.section3Body: Once your profile is validated by our team, it becomes visible to our German partner companies looking for your skills.
candidatsComment.section4Body: Visa procedures, departure preparation, first steps in Germany: we stay by your side at every stage.

candidatsEligibilite.title: Am I eligible?
candidatsEligibilite.subtitle: The basic criteria for joining the Karriere Fähre program.
candidatsEligibilite.section1Body: Be of legal age and have a serious plan to train or settle professionally in Germany.
candidatsEligibilite.section2Body: No level is required at sign-up. If you're already at B2, you go straight to placement. Otherwise, you follow our A1 → B2 training path.
candidatsEligibilite.section3Body: We prioritize shortage occupations in Germany: healthcare, hospitality, construction, industry and technical trades, IT. A qualification or experience in one of these fields is an advantage.
candidatsEligibilite.section4Title: Not sure? Let's talk it through
candidatsEligibilite.section4Body: The best way to know where you stand is a direct conversation. Book an appointment, no obligation.

candidatsDiplomes.title: Qualification recognition
candidatsDiplomes.subtitle: What to know before getting your qualification recognized in Germany.
candidatsDiplomes.section1Body: For many regulated occupations (healthcare in particular), Germany requires your diploma to be recognized as equivalent to a German one before you can practice.
candidatsDiplomes.section2Body: We help you identify the right authority for your occupation and target region, gather the right documents, and anticipate any upskilling measures required.
candidatsDiplomes.section3Title: What this means for your timeline
candidatsDiplomes.section3Body: Recognition can take several months. We factor it into your path from the start to avoid surprises on the visa and employer side.

candidatsVivre.title: Living in Germany
candidatsVivre.subtitle: What to expect once you're there, beyond the job.
candidatsVivre.section1Body: Registering with local authorities (Anmeldung), opening a bank account, finding housing: we prepare you for these steps before departure.
candidatsVivre.section2Body: B2 level lets you work, but daily life keeps demanding effort. We encourage continued learning once you're there.
candidatsVivre.section3Body: Karriere Fähre stays reachable after your arrival to guide you through any question or integration difficulty.

candidatsFaq.title: Candidate FAQ
candidatsFaq.subtitle: The most frequently asked questions about our program.
candidatsFaq.q1: Is Karriere Fähre paid for candidates?
candidatsFaq.a1: Terms vary by path (Fast Track or Full Training). Contact us or book an appointment to discuss the details.
candidatsFaq.q2: Do I need to already speak German to sign up?
candidatsFaq.a2: No. You can sign up with no prior knowledge and follow our full A1 → B2 path.
candidatsFaq.q3: How long does the full path take?
candidatsFaq.a3: About 10 months of training (A1 to B2), plus 1 month of exam preparation.
candidatsFaq.q4: Does Karriere Fähre guarantee a job in Germany?
candidatsFaq.a4: We guarantee serious support and matching with real partner companies. Final placement also depends on your profile and the interview with the employer.
candidatsFaq.a5: We prioritize shortage occupations in Germany (healthcare, hospitality, construction, industry, IT). Your profile and preferences are taken into account during matching.
candidatsFaq.q6: What happens if I don't reach B2 level?
candidatsFaq.a6: We adjust the training pace. Placement only happens once the required level is reached.

formations.title: Our trainings
formations.subtitle: Two paths depending on your current German level.

fastTrack.title: Fast Track: already at B2
fastTrack.body: If you already have German level B2 (certified or not), you can join our candidate pool directly for placement with our partner companies in Germany.

fullTraining.title: Full Training: complete A1 → B2 path
fullTraining.body: An intensive path structured around the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR), over about 10 months, plus 1 month of exam preparation.
fullTraining.examsBody: Goethe-Institut, TELC, ÖSD, TestDaF (B2 level). B1 exam available on request.
fullTraining.includes1: Opening and management of the student file
fullTraining.includes3: Student kit (badge, internal rules, learning materials, student guide)
fullTraining.includes4: Access to the online student area

formations.pricingNote: For pricing and payment details, contact us or book an appointment.

formationsAllemand.title: German courses A1 → B2
formationsAllemand.subtitle: The core of our Full Training path, from the very first course to the level required to work in Germany.
formationsAllemand.section1Body: A1, A2, B1, then B2: each level follows the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR), with groups progressing together over about 2 to 3 months per stage.
formationsAllemand.section2Title: Courses built for the German context
formationsAllemand.section2Body: Beyond grammar and vocabulary, our courses include professional vocabulary and everyday situations you'll face in Germany.
formationsAllemand.section3Body: Student file, badge, tracked attendance: we prepare our candidates with the same rigor expected in a German professional setting.

formationsExamens.title: Exam preparation
formationsExamens.subtitle: Goethe-Institut, TELC, ÖSD, TestDaF: exams recognized by employers and German authorities.
formationsExamens.section1Body: A recognized certificate (usually B2 level) is generally required for the work visa and directly reassures the employer about your actual level.
formationsExamens.section2Title: One dedicated month, at the end of the path
formationsExamens.section2Body: After reaching B2, one month of intensive preparation (about 80 hours) prepares you specifically for the format of your chosen exam.
formationsExamens.section3Body: We guide you toward the exam best suited to your target occupation and destination region. A B1-level exam is available on request.

formationsIntegration.title: Upskilling & integration
formationsIntegration.subtitle: Preparing to live and work in Germany, not just to speak the language.
formationsIntegration.section1Body: German workplace norms, punctuality, communicating with an employer, administrative life: we cover these topics during training, not just right before departure.
formationsIntegration.section2Body: If you already have some German but targeted gaps, we offer a shorter upskilling track instead of repeating the full A1 → B2 path.
formationsIntegration.section3Body: This preparation continues after your arrival in Germany, alongside our post-departure support.

entreprises.step2Body: Our team validates your company account to maintain the quality of our network.
entreprises.step3Body: Browse qualified candidate profiles, ready for placement or in training.
entreprises.step4Body: We support you through every step until the candidate arrives in Germany.

entreprisesServices.title: Our recruitment services
entreprisesServices.subtitle: A placement service built for German companies facing a labor shortage.
entreprisesServices.section1Body: We recruit and train Cameroonian and Central African candidates in the occupations where your needs are strongest: healthcare, hospitality, construction, industry, IT.
entreprisesServices.section2Body: Every profile you review has taken a German placement test. You never receive applications below the required level.
entreprisesServices.section3Body: We advise you on the legal framework for recruiting qualified foreign workers (Fachkräfteeinwanderungsgesetz) and the visa process on the candidate's side.

entreprisesProfils.title: Profiles & sectors available
entreprisesProfils.subtitle: A pool of trained, verified candidates, organized by shortage sector.
entreprisesProfils.section1Body: Healthcare, hospitality, construction & trades, industry & technical trades, IT: the sectors where German demand is strongest and where we focus our training.
entreprisesProfils.section2Body: Every candidate visible in our pool has been reviewed by our team: identity, German level, qualification or experience in the target occupation.
entreprisesProfils.section3Body: Access to full profiles (CV, contact details) is reserved for company accounts validated by our team, to protect our candidates' privacy.

entreprisesPartenariat.title: Become a partner company
entreprisesPartenariat.subtitle: Karriere Fähre works with German companies in sectors facing labor shortages, and is continually growing this network.
entreprisesPartenariat.section1Title: A partnership, not a one-off placement
entreprisesPartenariat.section1Body: Becoming a partner means building a lasting relationship with us: anticipating your recurring staffing needs rather than handling them one at a time.
entreprisesPartenariat.section2Title: What we expect from a partner
entreprisesPartenariat.section2Body: A clear legal framework, a serious welcome for the candidate on arrival, and transparent communication about the roles offered.
entreprisesPartenariat.section3Body: Priority access to our candidate pool, dedicated support, and visibility on our partners page.

entreprisesProcessus.title: Our process
entreprisesProcessus.subtitle: Visa, Fachkräfteeinwanderungsgesetz (Skilled Immigration Act): the legal framework explained simply.
entreprisesProcessus.section1Body: Since the Skilled Immigration Act (Fachkräfteeinwanderungsgesetz), Germany has made it easier for non-European skilled workers to enter shortage occupations. We track this closely to keep every case secure.
entreprisesProcessus.section2Title: The visa process on the candidate side
entreprisesProcessus.section2Body: Employment contract, qualification recognition if needed, consular appointment: we support the candidate at every step, in coordination with you.
entreprisesProcessus.section3Body: You provide the contract and the role details. We coordinate the case preparation and follow-up through to the candidate's arrival.

entreprisesPourquoi.title: Why Central Africa
entreprisesPourquoi.subtitle: What Cameroonian and Central African candidates bring to your company.
entreprisesPourquoi.section1Body: Cameroon and Central Africa have a young population looking for meaningful training and serious international career opportunities.
entreprisesPourquoi.section2Body: French-speaking backgrounds and, for some candidates, prior exposure to German, make it easier to learn quickly up to B2 level.
entreprisesPourquoi.section3Title: An agency that knows both sides
entreprisesPourquoi.section3Body: Founded by a German-French-Cameroonian entrepreneur, Karriere Fähre selects and trains its candidates with a precise understanding of your expectations as a German employer.

entreprisesDemande.title: Submit a staffing need
entreprisesDemande.subtitle: Tell us what you need, we take care of the rest.
entreprisesDemande.section1Body: The role in question, the number of people needed, the required German level and, if possible, your hiring timeline.
entreprisesDemande.section2Body: We validate your company account, then give you access to matching profiles in our candidate pool.
entreprisesDemande.section3Body: If you'd rather talk it through before creating an account, simply book an appointment with our team.
